articles.title: Australian airline Jetstar will charge passengers to use the overhead lockers for their bags - AP News
articles.description: Jetstar plans to charge passengers for using overhead compartments starting February 2027. The airline says this change aims to reduce stress at boarding gates by eliminating the need to weigh bags and find space in overhead lockers. Passengers can still stow…
